text: Men Nulii kadi e Madyana'en musiɗɗo makko on Shu'aybu, o m maaki: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, rewee Alla tun. Reweteeɗo haanduɗo e dewal alanaa on ko woori Mo. Wata on ɗuytu ɓetu ngun e manndake ɗen tuma etanton yimɓe ɓen. Min on miɗo yi'i on e yaajraaɓe arsike e neema. Wata on waɗtitir neema Alla on e mooɗon geddi. Min non miɗo hulani on lepte ñalaande fiiltotoonde kala gooto e mo'on, on heɓataa ka dogiri wanaa ka faaboɗon.
